_comment: Hand-maintained input. tools/pack/resolve_manifest.py turns this into manifest.json (exact versions, hashes, URLs, licences) by querying the Modrinth API. Edit this file, never manifest.json by hand.

pack.name: Kingdoms of the Long Night
pack.summary: Hardcore-survival fantasy kingdoms on NeoForge 1.21.1. Vast Tectonic/Terralith lands, medieval building, Ars Nouveau magic, and the longnight core mod that owns every person in the world.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Default preset. No shaders, no Distant Horizons. Recommended 6 GB RAM.

rich.title: Rich
rich.description: Adds Iris + Complementary Reimagined shaders, Distant Horizons and Sound Physics Remastered. Recommended 8 GB RAM and a mid/high-end GPU.

env_policy: client is always 'required' (singleplayer runs an integrated server, so world-gen/content mods are needed on the client too). server is 'unsupported' when the Modrinth project says server_side=unsupported, otherwise 'required', unless the entry sets server_env explicitly. Explicit server_env: 'optional' for mods that merely add extras when also on a dedicated server (maps, Jade, EMI, AppleSkin, Distant Horizons); 'unsupported' for Sound Physics (client feature).

mods.reason: Modern chunk renderer; the single biggest client FPS win.
Server/game-logic optimisations (AI, physics, chunk ticking) without changing vanilla behaviour.
Cuts memory use (blockstate/model dedup); important with 40 mods on 6 GB.
Faster launch, lower memory, many bug fixes for modded NeoForge.
Skips rendering hidden entities/block entities (helps in dense settlements).
Speeds up immediate-mode rendering (HUD, text, maps, signs).
Biome/time/weather ambience (wind, night insects, caves) for a lonely long-night mood.
Particle rain/snow and storm fog; cheap, strong weather atmosphere.
Reverb/occlusion for caves and halls. Rich preset only: costs CPU and the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 build is beta (1.5.x are alpha).
Continent-scale terrain, real mountain ranges and rivers: the 'long journey' Middle-earth scale. Ships built-in Terralith compatibility.

~100 vanilla-block biomes; Tectonic's documented companion (Tectonic ships the Terralith compat). Terralith's own structure sets - including 'fortified villages' full of villagers - are switched off in config/terralith.json (custom_structures=false) because longnight owns all NPCs.
Exploration: catacombs and fortresses with loot; no NPCs.
Exploration: varied, atmospheric abandoned mines; no NPCs.
Exploration: a real underground fortress; no NPCs.
Exploration: ruined temples worth raiding; no NPCs.
Pitched/attic/thatch-style roofs: the core of medieval silhouettes.
Arrow slits, gothic and parapet windows, shutters.
Wooden, barn, portcullis-style and stable doors.
Rope/log/stone bridges for roads across Tectonic rivers and gorges.
Castle walls, palisades and hedges for settlement defences.
Cobbled roads and paving between settlements.

mods.pin_reason: 4.0.0/4.0.1 were released hours ago (11 Oct 2026, new major, hotfix after 90 min); 3.9.9 is the last month-old 3.x release. Re-evaluate 4.0.x in a later pack update.
mods.reason: Medieval-feeling decor and utility (sacks, jars, signposts, flags, lanterns, hourglass, ropes). Its Red Merchant trader is disabled by our config because longnight owns all NPCs.
Rustic furniture (benches, tables, shelves, cupboards) for halls and homes.
Cooking, crops and preserved food: deeper hardcore food loop; official NeoForge 1.21.1 build.

The single player-facing arcane path (glyph spellcrafting, rituals). Chosen over Iron's Spells: 2 external deps (GeckoLib, Curios) vs 4 incl. a beta playerAnimator + Iron's Lib, and no humanoid NPC traders (Iron's adds Priest/Apothecarist/Wandering Magician/Pyromancer etc.).
Animation library required by Ars Nouveau (declared in its neoforge.mods.toml, NOT declared on Modrinth, so listed explicitly).
Accessory-slot API required by Ars Nouveau (declared in its neoforge.mods.toml, NOT declared on Modrinth, so listed explicitly).
Recipe viewer. Chosen over JEI: release channel on 1.21.1 (JEI 1.21.1 builds are beta and now need MezzConfig), no deps; Farmer's Delight and Ars Nouveau ship EMI plugins.
What-am-I-looking-at tooltip (blocks, mobs, growth stages).
Shows hunger/saturation values: essential for a hardcore food loop.
Minimap + waypoints for continent-scale travel (Fair-Play edition has no NeoForge 1.21.1 build).
Full-screen world map that pairs with the minimap.
Inventory drag/scroll handling; pure client QoL.

mods.pin_reason: Only Iris build for 1.21.1 NeoForge that targets Sodium 0.8 (the newest release, 1.8.12, targets Sodium 0.6 and Supplementaries declares Sodium < 0.8.12-beta.1 incompatible).
mods.reason: Shader loader (works on top of Sodium).
Level-of-detail terrain far beyond render distance: see mountain ranges days away. Config ships a moderate quality profile.
Shader pack (Complementary License 1.7: modpack use allowed when added via Modrinth/CurseForge systems, unmodified, credited). Enabled by default in the rich preset.

rejected.name: MineColonies
rejected.reason: Adds its own colonists/NPC society; longnight owns all NPCs (decision D2). (Its official builds are on CurseForge; the Modrinth 'minecolonies' project is an old 1.18.2 upload with no NeoForge 1.21.1 build.)

rejected.name: Millénaire
rejected.reason: Adds NPC villages and cultures; longnight owns all NPCs (D2). (Also not on Modrinth for NeoForge 1.21.1.)

rejected.name: Guard Villagers
rejected.reason: Adds NPC guards; longnight owns all NPCs (D2).

rejected.name: Villager Recruits / Recruits & Workers
rejected.reason: Recruitable NPC armies; longnight owns all NPCs (D2). (No NeoForge 1.21.1 build on Modrinth either.)

rejected.name: Towns and Towers
rejected.reason: Adds villages/outposts with villager NPCs; settlements and people come from longnight (D2/D3).

rejected.name: ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Village (CTOV)
rejected.reason: Village overhaul; villages are disabled and settlements come from longnight (D3).

rejected.name: Easy NPC
rejected.reason: Generic NPC framework; longnight owns all NPCs (D2).

rejected.name: Human Companions
rejected.reason: Recruitable human NPCs; longnight owns all NPCs (D2). (Not on Modrinth for NeoForge 1.21.1.)

rejected.name: Minecraft Comes Alive (MCA Reborn)
rejected.reason: Replaces villagers with a full NPC society (families, marriage); directly conflicts with longnight (D2). (Its NeoForge 1.21.1 file is a beta despite the 'release' tag.)

rejected.name: Terralith fortified villages (structure set terralith:rare_village)
rejected.reason: Terralith itself is kept, but it ships fortified villages full of villagers. The pack disables Terralith's custom structures (config/terralith.json custom_structures=false) until longnight overrides data/terralith/worldgen/structure_set/rare_village.json itself; see VERIFICATION.md.

rejected.name: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
rejected.reason: Magic: only one magic mod; Ars Nouveau chosen (fewer/lighter deps, no beta deps, no humanoid NPC traders such as Priest/Apothecarist/Wandering Magician).

rejected.name: IceAndFire Community Edition
rejected.reason: Exists for NeoForge 1.21.1 (2.0 release 18 Jul 2026, 2.1-beta.1 the same day) but not clearly stable: brand-new major line whose own page warns that version swaps corrupt saves (dangerous for a long hardcore world), heavy world-gen (roosts, caves, graveyards) and terrain-griefing dragons, plus 2 extra libs (Uranus, Jupiter). Dragons: not available as clearly stable - longnight will provide later.

rejected.name: Dragon Mounts Remastered
rejected.reason: Available (1.9.2) but PolyForm-Noncommercial, last update Sep 2025, tame-a-pet-dragon design rather than world threat; longnight will provide dragons later.

rejected.name: Ice and Fire (original)
rejected.reason: No NeoForge 1.21.1 version on Modrinth.

rejected.name: Noisium
rejected.reason: Last NeoForge 1.21.1 build Aug 2024 (project no longer actively updated for this branch) and it patches noise generation that Tectonic also reshapes; not worth the world-gen risk.

rejected.name: C2ME (NeoForge)
rejected.reason: Only alpha builds for NeoForge 1.21.1.

rejected.name: Visuality
rejected.reason: No NeoForge 1.21.1 version on Modrinth.

rejected.name: Falling Leaves
rejected.reason: No NeoForge 1.21.1 version on Modrinth. (A different 'falling-leaves' project exists: All-Rights-Reserved, ~8k downloads, unknown author - not trusted.)

rejected.name: JEI
rejected.reason: EMI chosen instead (JEI's NeoForge 1.21.1 builds are beta and now require MezzConfig).

rejected.name: JourneyMap

rejected.name: Xaero's Minimap (Fair-Play)
rejected.reason: No NeoForge 1.21.1 build on Modrinth; full edition used.

rejected.name: Controlling + Searchables
rejected.reason: Optional keybind-search QoL; cut to keep the pack at <=40 mods.

rejected.name: Macaw's Furniture
rejected.reason: Handcrafted chosen for furniture (more rustic); one furniture mod is enough.

rejected.name: Complementary Unbound / BSL / Bliss
rejected.reason: One shader is enough: BSL and Bliss are All-Rights-Reserved with no explicit modpack grant; Complementary Reimagined has an explicit modpack grant and is lighter than Unbound.
